mutation CreateService($name: String!, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $type: String, $repo: String, $image: String, $registryCredentialId: String, $branch: String, $rootDir: String, $runtime: String, $buildCommand: String, $startCommand: String, $dockerfilePath: String, $buildFilter: BuildFilterInput, $plan: String, $autoDeploy: Boolean, $schedule: String, $command: String, $publishPath: String, $port: Int, $envVars: [EnvVarInput], $secretFiles: [SecretFileInput]) {

    name: $name
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    type: $type
    repo: $repo
    image: $image
    registryCredentialId: $registryCredentialId
    branch: $branch
    rootDir: $rootDir
    runtime: $runtime
    buildCommand: $buildCommand
    startCommand: $startCommand
    dockerfilePath: $dockerfilePath
    buildFilter: $buildFilter
    plan: $plan
    autoDeploy: $autoDeploy
    schedule: $schedule
    command: $command
    publishPath: $publishPath
    port: $port
    envVars: $envVars
    secretFiles: $secretFiles
  ) {
    id
    name
    type
    phase
    projectId
    environmentId
    registryCredentialId
    latestDeployId
    __typename
  }
}

    clearCache: $clearCache

}
